title: Interactive task worksheet
intro: Classify four scenarios, then identify the main risk and the human responsibility.

items: Generate possible themes for a neighborhood event.
Decide whether chest pain is caused by anxiety.
Rewrite a long email so it is easier to understand.
Confirm the filing deadline for a current government program.

fields.label: Classification
options: Choose one
Well suited
Useful with human review
Poorly suited

challenge.prompt: Which task is the strongest fit for AI with ordinary human review?
options: Diagnose new chest pain
Rewrite a long internal email for clarity
Decide who should be fired
Confirm a current legal filing deadline without checking a source
challenge.explanation: Rewriting supplied text is a strong drafting task. Medical diagnosis, employment decisions, and current legal deadlines require stronger human control or authoritative sources.

title: Interactive task worksheet
intro: Choose the safest action for four scenarios, explain why, and identify the next step.

items: Create five names for a fictional character.
Review a confidential employee investigation file in a personal AI account.
Prepare questions for a doctor using a short, de-identified symptom summary.
Compare vacation ideas using general preferences and a budget range.

fields.label: Action
options: Choose one
Use AI normally
Use AI with safeguards
Use another source first
Do not use AI for this task

challenge.prompt: A document contains names, account numbers, and medical details. What should happen first?
options: Upload it and ask AI to remove the sensitive details
Minimize or de-identify the information before sharing anything
Use a longer prompt explaining that the file is confidential
Share it only after asking AI not to retain it
challenge.explanation: Privacy protection starts before information is shared. Remove or replace unnecessary identifying details and use an approved environment when sensitive information is genuinely required.

title: Build your task brief
intro: Draft each component, then combine it into one concise assignment.

challenge.prompt: Which instruction gives AI the clearest assignment?
options: Help me with a presentation
Create a five-slide briefing for supervisors that explains the new process, uses plain language, and ends with three implementation steps
Tell me everything about project communication
Make this better
challenge.explanation: The strongest assignment defines the deliverable, audience, purpose, constraints, and desired ending.

title: Design the staged request
intro: Create the request in stages and make the human review point explicit.

challenge.prompt: When is a staged request most useful?
options: When the task is trivial and the answer is obvious
When discovery or planning should be reviewed before the final output is produced
Whenever the prompt can be made longer
Only when AI refuses the first request
challenge.explanation: Staging creates deliberate review points before later work depends on an uncertain direction.

title: Write the repair instruction
intro: Diagnose the weak draft and request a focused revision without restarting useful work.

challenge.prompt: A draft has one weak section but the rest is useful. What is the best next move?
options: Start a new conversation and discard the draft
Ask for a focused revision that preserves the useful parts
Accept the entire draft to avoid inconsistency
Request three completely unrelated replacements
challenge.explanation: Focused repair preserves good work while clearly identifying what must change and why.

title: Plan the verified research brief
intro: Define the evidence and verification plan before writing conclusions.

challenge.prompt: Which claim most clearly requires direct source verification?
options: A brainstorming suggestion
A current eligibility deadline for a government program
A proposed outline heading
A tone preference
challenge.explanation: Current deadlines can change and have real consequences, so they should be checked against an authoritative current source.

title: Build the traceable information brief
intro: Record source limits, extracted facts, traceable locations, and unresolved issues.

fields.label: Page, section, table, or image references

challenge.prompt: What makes an AI-assisted information brief traceable?
options: It sounds confident
It includes exact page, section, table, or image references for important facts
It is longer than the source
It removes all uncertainty
challenge.explanation: Traceability lets the reader return to the source location and verify the claim.

title: Complete the writing and learning workflow
intro: Use one section for writing assistance and one for active learning design.

fields.label: Writing purpose, reader, and fixed facts

challenge.prompt: Which learning activity best tests understanding?
options: Reread the explanation
Copy the definition
Explain the idea in your own words and apply it to a new case
Highlight every sentence
challenge.explanation: Retrieval and transfer reveal whether the learner can use the idea, not merely recognize it.

title: Plan and compare the approaches
intro: Document the AI approach, project plan, and option comparison separately.

fields.label: Project plan, dependencies, owners, and risks

challenge.prompt: What should remain human-owned in an AI-assisted decision?
options: The formatting only
The final judgment, priorities, and acceptance of consequences
The first list of options only
Nothing once enough data is supplied
challenge.explanation: AI can structure options and surface tradeoffs, but the accountable person must own the judgment and consequences.

title: Build the high-stakes workflow
intro: Keep AI in a limited role and define the professional and human safeguards.

fields.label: Domain
options: Choose one
Health
Legal
Financial
Employment
Safety

fields.label: Decision owner and checks required before action

challenge.prompt: Which response is safest in a high-stakes domain?
options: Give a definitive answer whenever the user sounds worried
State limits, identify what requires professional review, and direct urgent situations to appropriate help
Avoid all useful information
Replace uncertainty with the most likely answer
challenge.explanation: High-stakes support should preserve uncertainty, define limits, and escalate when professional or urgent help is appropriate.

title: Create the reusable workflow
intro: Turn one success into an adaptable process and test it against a varied case.

challenge.prompt: What should be captured when turning a successful interaction into a reusable workflow?
options: Only the final answer
Inputs, sequence, review points, quality checks, and expected output
Every word from the original conversation
Only the tool name
challenge.explanation: A reusable workflow preserves the process and quality controls, not just one successful result.

title: Design the durable project workflow
intro: Create a restartable project record with clear gates, ownership, and next action.

fields.label: Personal AI workflow and review levels

challenge.prompt: What is most important in a project handoff?
options: A complete transcript with no prioritization
Current status, decisions, evidence, open issues, constraints, and the next action
A summary of only the earliest work
A promise that the next person can infer missing details
challenge.explanation: A good handoff allows continuation without reconstructing critical context or repeating settled decisions.
